title: DAILY SAINTS FEAST PODCAST - Videos
description:
Welcome to Daily Saints Feast Day Podcast . We follow the Vatican’s daily calendar to bring you the profound stories of those who walked the path of holiness before us.

Growing up, I had a life-changing dream during a retreat at age 12 that made Jesus my number one priority. Since then, I’ve realized that while living as a modern Christian is a challenge, the Saints provide us with the perfect roadmap.

In each 15–25 minute episode, we go beyond the surface. We research the Saint’s childhood, family, friendships, miracles, and their lasting contribution to the Catholic Church. Whether you are looking to change your life or simply understand the faith better, this channel is available anytime—just like the Bible—to help you follow Jesus Christ and become a better human being. Join our family as we journey together to the end of the world.
